title: Light Mexican Wrap
description: A simple and healthy Mexican-inspired wrap filled with lean turkey and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the turkey breast with salt and pepper.
Grill the turkey for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 74°C.
Let the turkey rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and sliced cucumber.
Warm the light wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the low-calorie salsa on the warmed wrap, then layering the sliced turkey, mixed greens, and vegetables.
